name: what about poe
source:
cherry blossom high, home of three(ish) eligible, romanceable boys!

Beaux, the cheer captain and town sweetheart!

Poe, resident snarky bookworm and poet!

Rue, school badboy and infamous delinquent!

...can YOU warm the hearts of these three(ish) boys?
